label: champ_0095_rival_02
text: I saw you going into the Gym and came running![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_03
text: Listen, I’m really sorry I couldn’t battle you last\ntime we ran into each other.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_04
text: Wait—don’t get me wrong! I didn’t chase you\ndown just to battle you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_05
text: Then again...I guess I wouldn’t MIND a battle or\nanything, if you wanted to... What do you say?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_07
text: C’mon! It’ll just be, like, a really short battle!\nI’ll only use four Pokémon! I promise![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_08
text: Wait, hold on... I wanna be sure to pick the right\nPokémon for where you’re at in your journey.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_09
text: Sorry, gimme a sec to fine-tune my team! Then\nwe can battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0095_rival_10
text: In fact, while you’re waiting, go ahead and take\non the Gym![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
